business_problem: MetLife describes friction in helping consumers discover, evaluate, and purchase pet insurance, while pet-care costs contribute to financial stress and delayed veterinary care.
solution_summary: MetLife Pet Insurance exposes its insurance application through a ChatGPT plugin. In the ChatGPT conversation, a pet parent supplies answers about the pet that are needed to complete an application; the experience then presents coverage options and a binding quote from MetLife Pet. The described serving path continues from the conversational experience to the MetLife Pet Insurance website, where the customer reviews the quote generated from the completed application and can finish purchasing a policy. This is a customer-facing integration between ChatGPT and MetLife's existing insurance portal and website, rather than a described back-end data platform. The announcement does not identify how application data is validated, what quote-processing services or storage retain it, or any APIs, identity controls, hosting, or operational components, so those implementation details cannot be specified.
